# RAD Advocates

> RAD Advocates is a nonprofit organization dedicated to educating families, professionals, and communities about Reactive Attachment Disorder and providing comprehensive support, training, and advocacy resources.

Based in Littleton, Colorado, RAD Advocates offers educational programs, professional clinical training, parent courses, and community events to support families navigating reactive attachment disorder and developmental trauma. The organization combines evidence-based resources with peer support and advocacy to empower parents and professionals.

## Key Topics

- Reactive Attachment Disorder (RAD)
- Parenting Support
- Family Advocacy
- Developmental Trauma
- Professional Education
- Foster Care
- Adoption
- Attachment Disorder
- Mental Health
- Nonprofit Mission
- Membership Programs
- Clinical Training
- Community Events
